build.description: Full build pipeline for Angular/Ionic apps: encrypt-env → nx build → strip-exif → inject-meta, with optional CSP nonce, SRI hash, and hardening steps.

flutter-build.description: Build or serve a Flutter application (web, APK, iOS). Wraps the Flutter CLI with --dart-define-from-file env wiring and optional --obfuscate support.

flutter-export.description: Export a FlutterFlow project into the local app directory via the FlutterFlow CLI.

capacitor.description: Run a Capacitor command (sync, open, add, copy) for android or ios inside an Ionic app folder.

clean.description: Remove a project's build outputs (dist, coverage) and, for Flutter apps, run flutter clean.
